metaChecks.label: Sprite pixels per unit
metaChecks.note: Must match the locked 20 PPU art standard.

metaChecks.label: Texture filter mode
metaChecks.note: Pixel art requires Point (no filter); Bilinear blurs source pixels.

metaChecks.label: Mip maps
metaChecks.note: Mip maps must be off for pixel art.

metaChecks.label: Texture compression
metaChecks.note: Lossy compression must be off for pixel art.

metaChecks.label: Sprite import mode
metaChecks.note: A sheet must import as Multiple so each cell is a named sprite.

metaChecks.label: Sliced sprite count
metaChecks.note: One sprite per direction row x frame column.

metaChecks.label: Sprite rect size
metaChecks.note: Every rect must match the locked 48x64 cell.

metaChecks.label: Sprite pivot
metaChecks.note: Bottom-center pivot keeps feet on the ground line.

metaChecks.label: Per-sprite alignment
metaChecks.note: Sliced sprites must keep the custom pivot instead of a default alignment.

metaChecks.label: Alpha is transparency
metaChecks.note: Transparent sprite edges must be treated as alpha.

metaChecks.label: Texture importer type
metaChecks.note: The importer must treat the texture as a sprite.

metaChecks.label: sRGB texture
metaChecks.note: Colour art must import as sRGB.

metaChecks.label: Wrap mode
metaChecks.note: Clamp sampling prevents neighbouring cells bleeding in.

metaChecks.label: Sprite mesh type
metaChecks.note: Tight meshes trim transparent pixels; FullRect keeps a stable frame rect for animation.

metaChecks.label: Sprite extrude
metaChecks.note: Extrude above 1 px can bleed neighbouring cells.

metaChecks.label: Max texture size
metaChecks.note: Import size must not clamp the sheet.
